dct_description_sm: Water cytotoxicity testing results are calculated values. Raw data files can be provided upon request.

This dataset contains all data used for analysis in the report, "Post-Horse River Wildfire Surface Water Quality Monitoring Using the Water Cytotoxicity Test," including results of water cytotoxicity testing, routine water chemistry, and trace element analysis. The analyzed water samples were collected from environmental surface waters, drinking water treatment plants, drinking water taps, and wastewater treatment plants in Northern Alberta from 2017-2020 to assess the impact of the 2016 Horse River Wildfire on water quality in the Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo (Alberta, Canada).
